# `company/v1` — company.md — company metadata

<!-- AUTOGENERATED from `Glorbo.FileSpec.CompanyMd` by
     `mix glorbo.docs.file_formats`. Do not edit by hand;
     regen after changing the spec module. -->

Top-level metadata for a company directory. Declares the
canonical slug, the display name, and optional goals list
consumed by GoalsLive and the per-goal Kanban filter.

## Frontmatter schema

**Required:** `kind`, `slug`, `name`

**Optional:** `description`, `mission`, `created_at`, `goals`, `icon`, `budget`, `headcount_budget`, `template`, `template_version`, `provider_pin`, `model_pin`, `imported_from`

### Patterns

| Key | Regex |
|-----|-------|
| `slug` | `\A[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}\z` |


## Canonical key order

When the formatter rewrites this file, keys appear in this order:

`kind`, `slug`, `name`, `description`, `mission`, `icon`, `budget`, `headcount_budget`, `template`, `template_version`, `provider_pin`, `model_pin`, `created_at`, `goals`

Unknown keys fall after the known block, sorted alphabetically.

## Examples

```markdown
---
kind: company/v1
slug: acme
name: Acme
description: Test company
goals:
  - slug: ship-v5
    name: Ship v0.0.5
---
# Acme

A one-person shop shipping small useful things.
```
